    • generatesKey

      public static String generatesKey(EncryptionUtils.AESKeyLength bitLength)
      This method generates a (pseudo)random key for using the authentication or encryption feature. Instead of generating a key and transmit it on a different channel to the counterpart, you can also use the key generation and exchange functions of this framework. You will find the required information in the ICD or by exploring the other Java files in this package.
      Gibt zurück:
      BASE64 encoded key of the desired bit length. The bit length is 128 bits/16 bytes or 256 bits/32 bytes.

    • checkKey

      public static boolean checkKey(byte[] key)
      Checks if the given key is usable for authentication or encryption (ECB).
      Parameter:
      key - Secret key
      Gibt zurück:
      true means the key is usable, false means not. In the last case for instance the key lenght doesn't match of something else.

    • checkKey

      public static boolean checkKey(byte[] key, byte[] iv)
      Checks if the given key is usable for authentication or encryption (CTR/CFB).
      Parameter:
      key - Secret key
      iv - Initialization Vector
      Gibt zurück:
      true means the key is usable, false means not. In the last case for instance the key lenght doesn't match of something else.
